acceptance: A planner runs the open brainstorm session multi-operator-0-3-2 (technical lens) through both rounds with its seed notes, records the ideas with specy-road brainstorm add-idea, and recommends a ranked set with specy-road brainstorm recommend
The maintainer accepts or rejects the recommended ideas; accepted ones are promoted to roadmap nodes for 0.3.2 with specy-road brainstorm promote, and the session is closed
Nothing is built in this leaf: its output is the brainstorm record and the promoted nodes
nodes.title: Run the multi-operator brainstorm for 0.3.2 (two or more operators on several machines, plus a PM in the PM GUI)

acceptance: A worker turn that merges or fast-forwards the integration branch reports no committed_outside_zones finding for paths changed only by commits reachable from the integration ref; a path the leaf's own commit changes outside its zones is still reported
The check reads the integration ref the worker state already records, and an unreadable ref is a check_error finding, never a silent pass
One test through the public post-run check covers both cases (integration-only path, leaf-own out-of-zone path); CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry
nodes.title: The post-run zone check counts only the leaf's own commits, not integration commits a merge brings in

acceptance: When the commit under review has unplanned removal findings against its merge base, a reviewer's delta packet no longer states 'no integrity findings'; either the packet keeps the 'Required check: unplanned test removal' entries and the reviewer answers them, or review record carries them over from that reviewer's approve of the prior commit when the delta changes none of the listed tests. Seen 2026-11-19: four refused approves in a row at one commit until a full packet was built
A test reproduces the loop (approve at commit A with unplanned removals, one-line delta to B, delta approve at B) and shows the record is accepted
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] records the fix; no version heading is written
nodes.title: A delta review packet carries the required test-removal check, so a delta approve is not refused

acceptance: scripts/vulture_whitelist.py lists no name that no longer exists after M16.7.6's renames (line 66 as of 2026-11-19), and the vulture check passes
nodes.title: Remove the stale vulture whitelist entry left by the private-to-public renames

acceptance: human: the maintainer's earmark (2026-11-20) is carried into the 0.3.2 plan: the multi-operator brainstorm (M23.10) takes it as a maintainer seed, and the plan that comes out either promotes it to build leaves or records why not

The plan keeps the earmark's boundaries: the service augments git worktree and file orchestration and does not replace it for a single developer; it coordinates several developers' orchestrators where files in git are hard to manage; it gives one or more PMs the whole picture and can route overall design decisions to them
The plan states how this sits with the 2026-10-27 decisions it revisits (no MCP server, no daemon): what runs as a service, who hosts it, and what still works with the service absent
nodes.title: 0.3.2 earmark: a coordination API service for several developers' orchestrators and their PMs, alongside git
